text_block_list.text: The Japanese Derby is finally here.

Winning Ticket worries whether she will be 
able to make the fans dream through this 
race, just as she once dreamed herself.

However, seeing the fans cheering for her 
on the live broadcast of the racetrack, 
Winning Ticket's anxiety melted away.

To live up to their expectations, she 
stepped out onto the grand stage she had 
always dreamed of.
